bmt-2024-calculus-04.prompt: Find the positive, real value of $k$ where $e^{kx}=3\sqrt x$ has exactly $1$ solution.

bmt-2024-calculus-05.prompt:
For a real number $n$, let $\lfloor n\rfloor$ be the greatest integer less than or equal to $n$. Compute
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\int_0^n\frac{x\lfloor x\rfloor}{n^3}\,dx.$$

bmt-2024-calculus-06.prompt:
What is the smallest positive integer $n>1$ such that
$$\int_1^n\sqrt{\sqrt{3+\sqrt x}-2}\;dx$$
is rational?

bmt-2024-calculus-09.prompt:
Given an infinite sequence of real numbers $x_0,x_1,x_2,\dots$ where for $i\ge0$,
$$x_{i+1}=\frac{4x_i^3-1}{6x_i^2-3},$$
there are exactly three possible real values, $a<b<c$, that $\lim_{n\to\infty}x_n$ may converge to, depending on $x_0$. A real number $m$ satisfies the condition that, for all $x_0<m$, the sequence converges to $a$. Find the maximum possible value of $m+a$.

bmt-2024-calculus-10.prompt:
Let a function $f(n)$ satisfy $f(1)=0$, and for positive integers $n>1$,
$$f(n)=\begin{cases}f\left(\frac n2\right)+\ln2,&\text{if }n\text{ is even}\\[2pt]\frac{f(n-1)+f(n+1)}{2},&\text{if }n\text{ is odd.}\end{cases}$$
Find the value of
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac1{2^n}\sum_{k=2^n}^{2^{n+1}}|\ln k-f(k)|.$$
